Yes — British citizens (Brits) can visit Vietnam visa-free. Under a unilateral exemption, UK passport holders can stay for up to 45 days without a visa. This exemption is currently valid until 2028-03-05 (extended per a March 2025 announcement).

Key details:
- Max stay visa-free: 45 days
- Agreement type: Unilateral exemption
- Valid until: 2028-03-05
- Your passport must be valid for at least 180 days from your date of entry.

If you need to stay longer than 45 days, an e-Visa is also available to all nationalities (including the UK) for stays up to 90 days, costing USD 25 (single entry) or USD 50 (multiple entry), with 2-3 business day processing. You can apply at https://evisa.gov.vn/.

Note: This data is current as of 2026-08-17. Visa policies can change, so it's worth double-checking the latest rules at https://evisa.gov.vn/ before you travel.
